Are the Rs 24.9bn of short-term loans being rolled over, and on what terms?

Does the Dubai trading arm restart or close (no sales since April 2026)?

changeLog.summary: Requested from Telegram (/update LGL). Added the interim to 30 September 2026. The LPG business made an operating loss in July–September (gross loss); group loss to owners Rs 1.54bn for the quarter, Rs 2.12bn for the half; NAV minus Rs 12.88. Restatement: year to March 2026 loss to owners Rs 4.90bn (was 3.344), EPS -12.66 (was -8.64), NAV -7.11 (was -3.06), no reason given. Cut LPG cash profit to 1.5/2.3/3.0bn and base turnaround EPS to Rs 0.30; ships book 17.6bn; net debt 32.6bn. Fair value 7.9 → 5.7. Still 0 of 4 business tests: avoid for now (unchanged).
